summary: First test run for DrillStock Pro (Expo + FastAPI + Mongo, Zoho mocked). Backend: 24/24 pytest tests passed covering auth, role scoping, stock request (idempotent, over-qty 400, approve/reject/cancel, double-approve 409, return increments), cycle count flow with discrepancies, equipment checkout/return damaged + maintenance + 409 double-checkout + overdue EQ-1003 seed, upload+file retrieval, bin create/archive (empty vs non-empty 400), QR label data_uri, scan resolver (bin/equipment/404), Zoho settings/connect/sync-log mock, dashboard, notifications unread/read-all, low-stock report. Frontend (390x844 mobile viewport): login screen loads, demo buttons work for admin and driller, dashboards render with user name & Zoho mock pill, tab nav works, Stock search 'HQ' returns products, product detail shows Take/Return + warehouse qty + movement history, new-request-screen reachable, Scan screen shows manual entry (web camera disabled correctly), Equipment screen renders with filters, sign-out from More tab works. No red-screen errors or deprecated Expo packages detected.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~1000 lines; splitting into routers (auth, stock, equipment, zoho, counts) would improve maintainability but is not blocking.
scope_wh raises 403 inside list_requests via driller branch not reached — logic is correct; just noted.
In approve_request, if zoho_adjust succeeds but apply_stock later fails and compensations run, the Zoho mock txn has already been logged as success. Acceptable for mock mode; flag when going live.
seed_data_creation: Created transient test bins (QLD-T****), stock requests (TEST client_refs), one count, one equipment checkout+return damaged. All ephemeral — no destructive edits to seeded data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: pytest file /app/backend/tests/test_drillstock.py is reusable (fixtures use idempotent login + unique client_refs). Frontend uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL) — tests default to it. Scan manual input lacks a specific testID; use input[type='text'] selector or add testID='scan-manual-input' and testID='scan-lookup-button' for cleaner selectors. More tab logout works via data-testid='logout-button'.
